name: Junead Khan
title: Quit Microsoft before Treasury had paying customers
why: Y Combinator said no, and he launched anyway, with savings and vested stock as his way back if it failed.

name: Jamie McGowan
title: A pond protist that breaks the genetic code
why: He was only testing a sequencing method, but he knew the genetic code well enough to notice two stop codons doing something no other known organism does.

name: Vincent Luis
title: Won the Ironman World Championship on his debut
why: Missing the Paris 2024 team ended his short-course career. That pushed him into long course, where he won his biggest title at 37.

name: Austin Smotherman
title: First PGA Tour win, in his 100th start
why: Eleven years as a pro, mini-tours, a tour card won, lost and won back. He kept going, and the win came on start 100.

name: Zizou Bergs
title: Beat Carlos Alcaraz in Shanghai
why: He calls himself a slow riser. He stuck with the same coach and kept at it until he got the biggest win of his career.
